news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to about $1.93 million on expanded PENFS/IB-Stim reimbursement and 60% higher unit deliveries, but the per-share loss ($0.19) came in wider than expected and revenue missed the roughly $2 million consensus. Shares fell nearly 7% to about $6.40 following the report despite 230 bps of gross-margin expansion and cash of $8.3 million as of June 30.

news.headline: Q2 earnings call: VA contract ramp and new sales/marketing leadership highlighted
news.source: Motley Fool / Investing.com (Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
news.summary: Management said the Veterans Affairs Federal Supply Schedule contract is beginning to open access to roughly 7 million VA patients annually, and pointed to a newly aligned full-time VP of Sales and VP of Marketing (effective May 1) as key go-to-market drivers. Cash used in operations improved to $1.0 million from $1.5 million a year earlier.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical-policy coverage for Percutaneous Electrical Nerve Field Stimulation (PENFS), adding over 500,000 covered lives, primarily benefiting patients in the Mid-Atlantic region. CEO Brian Carrico framed the win as reinforcing the reimbursement pathway created by the new Category I CPT code.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a same-day 9:00am ET conference call hosted by CEO Brian Carrico and CFO Tim Henrichs.

news.headline: NeurAxis declares Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board declared a second-quarter 2026 dividend on Series B Preferred Stock payable in roughly 80,463 shares of common stock rather than cash, issued July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21. The stock-only dividend structure preserves cash as the company scales commercial spending.

news.headline: NeurAxis independent directors receive equity compensation grants
news.summary: Independent directors Bradley Watkins, Jane Keyser, and Kristin Ferge each received board-compensation stock grants (roughly 26,000-31,000 shares at $6.28) on August 13, 2026, filed with the SEC on August 17. These were routine board-service equity awards rather than open-market purchases.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results and business update call
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's 2026 cadence (Q1 reported May 12, Q2 reported Aug 11), Q3 2026 results and conference call are expected in mid-November 2026; date not yet formally announced.

catalysts.label: Additional commercial payer medical-policy coverage wins for PENFS
catalysts.detail: Following the Category I CPT code (effective Jan 1, 2026) and the Aug 4 Mid-Atlantic expansion (+500,000 covered lives), further insurer medical-policy adoptions are a recurring near-term catalyst for reimbursed IB-Stim/PENFS volume.

catalysts.label: VA Federal Supply Schedule contract ramp
catalysts.detail: The VA FSS contract (effective December 1, 2025) opening access to roughly 7 million VA patients annually is still in early ramp; increasing VA order/utilization volume is a watch item for coming quarters.

catalysts.label: Investigator-initiated clinical trial readouts (functional dyspepsia RCT, pediatric CVS RCT)
catalysts.detail: A multi-site adult functional dyspepsia RCT and a pediatric Cyclic Vomiting Syndrome RCT are underway (including NIH-funded work with Emory/Atlanta VA); data readouts could support future label/indication expansion but timing is not yet confirmed.

pulse: NeurAxis's reimbursement-driven growth story continued in Q2 2026 with revenue up 116% year-over-year to ~$1.9 million on the new Category I CPT code and expanding payer coverage (+500,000 lives added August 4), but the stock sold off after a wider-than-expected EPS loss and a slight revenue miss versus consensus. Cash stood at $8.3 million as of June 30 with operating cash burn improving, while the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract and new sales/marketing leadership are still in early ramp. Key things to watch: further payer medical-policy wins, VA channel traction, cash runway/dilution via the ATM facility, and the Q3 2026 report expected around mid-November.
